Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.33 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing) > Audacity 3.0.2 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Jeff Coffin - Saxophone, Flute
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

^ brief stop time intro, salsa jam
& Swim Naked outro
* Can't Help Falling In Love interpolation
% Sojourn of Arjuna interpolation
# Carter solo intro
$ Crowd led "Thank You (Falettinme Be Mice Elf Agin)" interpolation
~ Also Sprach Zarathustra and Heartbreaker interpolations
+ Different intro, Dave lyrical flubs
! Carter solo intro, "Freeway Jam" (Jeff Beck) interpolation, Hoe Down interpolation, Down By the Riverside interpolation
? includes prelude, Schism interpolation, This Land Is Your Land interpolation
£ includes third verse/chorus

Banging can be heard through the set, especially during towards the second half of the tape.

Thank you to Ryan Jonik from Nine Inch Nails Live (ninlive.com) for the gear.
